club: Maples Tech Club (MTC) — Learn it. Build it. Ship it.

questions.question_text: To type a single capital letter or the "@" symbol above the number 2 without turning on Caps Lock, which key do you hold?
Which shortcut opens a brand-new blank document or window in most apps?
In a web browser like Chrome or Edge, what does pressing Ctrl + T do?
In a web browser, what does pressing Ctrl + W do?
Which key on a Windows keyboard is used to capture a screenshot of your entire screen?
When a file or folder is selected on Windows, pressing which function key lets you RENAME it immediately?
What does pressing Alt + F4 do on a Windows computer?
questions.option_c: Closes the currently active app or window

questions.question_text: In a browser, pressing Ctrl and the "+" (plus) key together does what?
questions.option_a: Zooms in to make text and images appear larger

questions.question_text: After zooming in on a webpage, pressing Ctrl + 0 (zero) does what?
questions.option_c: Resets the page zoom back to normal (100%)

questions.question_text: When filling out an online form (like Name, Roll No, Class), pressing the Tab key usually does what?
questions.option_b: Moves the cursor neatly to the next input box

questions.question_text: If you step away from a computer for a minute, which Windows shortcut immediately LOCKS your screen?
Which Windows shortcut minimizes all open windows at once so you can see the Desktop?
You accidentally closed an important tab in Chrome/Edge! Which lifesaver shortcut reopens the last closed tab?
What happens when you delete a file using Shift + Delete instead of just pressing Delete?
questions.option_a: It moves the file to Desktop
questions.option_d: It permanently deletes the file without sending it to the Recycle Bin

questions.question_text: Which Windows shortcut opens File Explorer ("This PC" / Folders) directly?
While typing a sentence, holding Ctrl and pressing Backspace (Ctrl + Backspace) erases what?
questions.option_a: The entire word to the left of the cursor at once

questions.question_text: Which function key toggles Full-Screen mode ON or OFF in almost all web browsers?
If a program freezes on Windows, which direct shortcut opens Task Manager immediately?
What is the main job of the small spinning fan inside a laptop or desktop cabinet?
questions.option_b: To keep the processor and internal parts cool so the computer does not overheat
questions.option_c: To blow dust onto the screen

questions.question_text: In everyday phones and computers, what is the simple difference between RAM and Storage (SSD/ROM)?
questions.option_a: RAM holds active apps temporarily while working; Storage keeps your photos and files saved even when powered off
questions.option_b: Both are names for the screen
questions.option_d: RAM stores photos forever; Storage deletes everything on restart

questions.question_text: If your computer opens 15 browser tabs and starts feeling sluggish when switching apps, having more of which part helps most?
Modern laptops use an SSD instead of an older spinning Hard Disk (HDD). What everyday benefit do you notice right away?
questions.option_b: The laptop boots up and opens apps much faster, with no moving disk parts
questions.option_d: You never need to charge the battery

questions.question_text: Which newer oval-shaped reversible charging/data port is found on almost all modern Android phones and newer laptops?
What do we call the main circuit board inside a computer that connects the processor, RAM, storage, and ports together?
If a wireless mouse stops moving the cursor on screen, what is the FIRST simple hardware thing you should check?
questions.option_a: Check if its battery is low or its tiny power switch underneath is turned OFF

questions.question_text: A pen-like tool used by digital artists and students to write or draw neatly on a tablet screen is called a:
Which storage capacity is LARGER when comparing a pendrive or laptop storage?
Roughly how many Gigabytes (GB) make 1 Terabyte (TB) on a hard drive?
Before pulling out a USB pendrive while files are copying, why should you wait or click "Eject"?
questions.option_a: Otherwise the monitor turns black forever
questions.option_b: Pulling it out mid-write can corrupt or damage the files being saved

questions.question_text: Which computer component is specially helpful for smooth 3D video editing, animation, and modern games?
Why should you NEVER block the air vents on the bottom of a laptop by placing it deep into a thick blanket for hours?
questions.option_c: It makes the screen brightness drop to zero
questions.option_d: Blocked vents trap heat inside, causing overheating, slow performance, and battery wear

questions.question_text: A desktop monitor is turned ON, its power light is blinking, and it says "No Signal." What is the most likely practical cause?
questions.option_b: Caps Lock is pressed on the keyboard
questions.option_c: Either the CPU cabinet is OFF or the HDMI/VGA display cable between the CPU and monitor is loose

questions.question_text: What is the difference between putting a laptop to "Sleep" versus "Shut Down"?
questions.option_b: Shut Down uses more battery than playing games
questions.option_d: Sleep keeps open work ready in low-power memory for instant wake-up; Shut Down closes everything completely

questions.question_text: What does screen resolution like "1920 × 1080 (Full HD)" describe on a monitor or phone?
questions.option_a: How many files can fit on the desktop
questions.option_b: The weight of the monitor in grams
questions.option_c: The grid of tiny pixels (width × height) that makes up the sharpness of the display

questions.question_text: An "All-in-One" desktop PC in a modern lab has no separate tower box on the desk. Where are its processor, RAM, and SSD located?
questions.option_b: Built neatly right behind the monitor screen itself

questions.question_text: Why do ink-tank or laser printers usually cost much less per page for a school office than tiny cheap ink-cartridge printers?
questions.option_d: Refill ink bottles and toner print thousands of pages at a fraction of the cost per page

questions.question_text: Which long bar at the bottom of a Windows screen shows the Start button, pinned apps, and clock?
Why do many students turn on "Dark Mode" in apps when reading or working in the evening?
questions.option_a: It uses a dark background that feels gentler on the eyes in low light
questions.option_b: It makes Wi-Fi twice as fast
questions.option_d: It prints pages in black paper

questions.question_text: If you want to jot down a quick plain-text note with zero heavy formatting, which lightweight built-in Windows app opens instantly?
When saving an image with a transparent background (such as a school logo), which image format supports transparency cleanly?
On Windows, files ending in ".exe" (or ".apk" on Android) are what kind of files?
questions.option_d: Application installer / executable program files (only run from trusted official sources!)

questions.question_text: Before editing an important project presentation, why is naming files clearly like "Science_Poster_v2_Final.pptx" better than "asdf123.pptx"?
questions.option_a: Computers refuse to save short names
questions.option_d: Clear file names let you and your teammates find the right version in seconds without confusion

questions.question_text: What does the "Spell Check" wavy red underline in Word or Google Docs indicate?
questions.option_a: That the sentence will be deleted automatically
questions.option_b: A word that may have a spelling typo so you can review and fix it
questions.option_c: That the computer has a virus

questions.question_text: If a single app stops responding ("Not Responding") on Windows, how can you close JUST that stuck app without unplugging the whole PC?
questions.option_b: Pull the electric plug from the wall
questions.option_c: Open Task Manager, select the frozen app, and click "End Task"

questions.question_text: What is "Open-Source Software" (such as Linux, VLC, Blender, or LibreOffice)?
questions.option_a: Software whose source code is openly shared so anyone can use, study, and improve it legally
questions.option_b: Software that works only for 1 hour
questions.option_d: Software that leaves your computer unlocked to strangers

questions.question_text: When you install a new PDF app and Windows asks which "Default App" should open .pdf files, what does that setting control?
questions.option_a: Which program opens automatically whenever you double-click any .pdf file

questions.question_text: In Google Docs or Microsoft 365 Online, what is a huge everyday advantage of "Auto-Save" to the cloud?
questions.option_a: It writes your homework by itself
questions.option_b: Your latest edits are saved continuously, so a sudden power cut does not wipe out an hour of typing
questions.option_d: It works without turning on the screen

questions.question_text: What is the purpose of Windows Security / Antivirus software on a PC?
questions.option_c: To detect and block harmful malware or infected downloads before they damage your files
questions.option_d: To clean physical dust off the keyboard

questions.question_text: Why do phones and laptops let you turn off unnecessary "Startup Apps" in Settings?
questions.option_a: It turns off the screen color
questions.option_d: Fewer heavy apps launching automatically at boot makes the computer start up faster and saves memory

questions.question_text: When you download a `.zip` archive of club photos, why should you "Extract All" before editing the photos inside?
questions.option_a: Otherwise the photos turn black and white
questions.option_d: Extracting unpacks the compressed files into a normal folder so apps can open and save changes properly

questions.question_text: What does "Version History" in Google Docs, Slides, or Sheets let a student team do?
questions.option_b: See earlier saved versions of a document and restore work if someone accidentally erased a section
questions.option_c: See every website visited on the computer

questions.question_text: If you copy a song file onto your Desktop as a "Shortcut" (tiny arrow on the icon) and then copy ONLY that shortcut to a pendrive, what happens at school?
questions.option_a: It converts the song into a video
questions.option_c: It will NOT play, because a shortcut is only a pointer link — not the actual `.mp3` song file itself!

questions.question_text: What is a `.csv` (Comma-Separated Values) file commonly used for between apps like Excel, Google Sheets, and portals?
questions.option_a: Importing or exporting simple clean rows and columns of table data (like student lists or questions)

questions.question_text: On a phone or computer, what is the difference between "Clearing App Cache" and "Clearing App Data / Storage"?
questions.option_a: Clearing Cache removes temporary files safely; Clearing Data resets the app like a fresh install and logs you out
questions.option_b: Clearing Cache deletes all your contacts

questions.question_text: Why do websites sometimes ask you to tick "I am not a robot" or pick traffic lights (CAPTCHA)?
questions.option_a: To stop automated spam bots from creating fake accounts or flooding forms
questions.option_b: To test your eyesight for driving

questions.question_text: In Chrome or Edge, which shortcut opens your recent Downloads list directly inside the browser?
What are website "Cookies" in everyday browsing?
questions.option_c: Tiny text files saved by websites in your browser to remember things like your login status or dark-mode preference

questions.question_text: In Google Search, putting quotation marks around an exact phrase like `"Maples Academy Khatauli"` helps you find:
questions.option_b: Pages that do NOT mention Maples Academy
questions.option_d: Pages containing that exact phrase with those words together in that order

questions.question_text: What is Google Drive or Microsoft OneDrive an example of?
questions.option_a: A physical pendrive inside your pocket
questions.option_d: Cloud storage — lets you save files online and open or share them from any phone or computer

questions.question_text: When sharing a Google Drive project link with your teacher, why should you check whether access is set to "Restricted" vs "Anyone with the link can View"?
questions.option_a: View access lets anyone delete your account
questions.option_b: If left "Restricted", your teacher will see "Access Denied" when clicking your submitted link!

questions.question_text: On a noisy browser tab playing unexpected music, what does the tiny speaker icon on that tab let you see or do?
questions.option_c: Spot immediately which tab is playing sound and even mute that tab

questions.question_text: What does an email ending in `.edu.in`, `.ac.in`, or `.gov.in` in India tell you about the website/sender?
questions.option_a: It belongs to a verified Indian educational institution (`.edu.in`/`.ac.in`) or government body (`.gov.in`)
questions.option_d: Anyone can buy it anonymously for ₹10 without verification

questions.question_text: If you start writing an email in Gmail and close the tab before clicking Send, where is your unfinished message saved automatically?
What is a "Browser Extension" (or Add-on)?
questions.option_b: A small optional helper tool added inside your browser (which you should install ONLY from trusted creators)

questions.question_text: If you want to save an online exam admit card or receipt neatly so you can view it offline anytime without internet, what can you select in the Print (`Ctrl + P`) destination menu?
When a random flashy website suddenly asks "Allow this site to send you Notifications?", what is the smart habit if you do not need alerts from it?
questions.option_c: Always click Allow on every site
questions.option_d: Click "Block" — allowing shady sites to send notifications floods your screen with fake virus/ad pop-ups!

questions.question_text: When sending an email announcement to 50 parents or students who do not know each other, why is `BCC` better than `CC`?
questions.option_d: `BCC` (Blind Carbon Copy) keeps everyone’s email address private from the other recipients

questions.question_text: In an email thread sent to 40 club members, what happens if you click "Reply All" instead of "Reply"?
questions.option_b: Your reply goes to ALL 40 people in the group instead of just the sender!

questions.question_text: Look closely at two URLs: `https://sbi.co.in` vs `https://sbi-login-kyc.freehost.xyz`. In the second URL, which company actually owns the real website domain?
questions.option_c: `freehost.xyz` — the `sbi-login-kyc` part at the front is just a fake subdomain trick!

questions.question_text: If a webpage looks broken or keeps showing an outdated version even after refreshing, what browser step usually fixes it?
questions.option_a: Hard Refresh (`Ctrl + F5`) or clearing cached images and files for that site

questions.question_text: In Chrome/Edge, why is creating separate "Browser Profiles" helpful when two siblings share one home laptop?
questions.option_a: Each sibling gets their own separate bookmarks, history, and logged-in school accounts without mixing them up
questions.option_b: It doubles the laptop hard disk size

questions.question_text: Why shouldn’t you blindly trust a shortened mystery link (like `bit.ly/3xYz99`) sent by an unknown stranger?
questions.option_a: Short links only work on desktop PCs
questions.option_b: Shortened links hide the real destination website URL until clicked, so they can disguise phishing or scam sites
questions.option_d: Short links use 10 GB of data

questions.question_text: If ONE Wi-Fi printer is connected to the school office Wi-Fi router, how many computers on that same Wi-Fi can print to it?
questions.option_b: All authorized computers/phones on that same Wi-Fi network can share and print to it wirelessly
questions.option_c: Only phones with no SIM card
questions.option_d: Only a computer plugged into it with an HDMI cable

questions.question_text: When you mirror your phone or laptop screen wirelessly onto a classroom Smart TV without any cable, what is that feature called?
Every device connected to a network gets an identifying number address (like a house number for delivering data packets). What is it called?
You are using a 1.5 GB/day mobile data pack via Hotspot. Watching 2 hours of video at `4K / 2160p` vs `480p` will do what?
questions.option_d: `4K` uses many times more mobile data and can finish your 1.5 GB pack very quickly!

questions.question_text: On a laptop connected to someone’s mobile Hotspot, turning ON "Metered Connection" (or Data Saver) helps because:
questions.option_b: It pauses huge background Windows updates so your friend’s mobile data does not drain suddenly

questions.question_text: On modern dual-band home Wi-Fi routers, you often see two Wi-Fi names: `Home_2.4G` and `Home_5G`. What is the practical difference?
questions.option_a: There is no difference at all
questions.option_b: `5G` Wi-Fi requires a 5G SIM card inside the router
questions.option_c: `5 GHz` gives faster speeds nearby in the same room; `2.4 GHz` reaches farther through walls

questions.question_text: What is "Quick Share / Nearby Share / AirDrop" on modern phones and laptops used for?
questions.option_a: Sending photos or project files fast between two nearby devices wirelessly without wasting internet data
questions.option_d: Charging another phone from 10 meters away

questions.question_text: Why should you avoid logging into banking or sensitive accounts on an open, password-free public Wi-Fi at a railway station or café?
questions.option_a: Unsecured open Wi-Fi networks make it easier for attackers nearby to snoop on traffic or set up fake twin hotspots
questions.option_c: Public Wi-Fi breaks your phone camera

questions.question_text: In online video calls or multiplayer games, what does "High Ping / High Latency" (e.g., 450 ms instead of 25 ms) feel like?
questions.option_b: A noticeable delay or lag between clicking/speaking and getting a response back

questions.question_text: What brings ultrahigh-speed broadband into modern schools and homes using hair-thin strands of glass carrying pulses of light?
If the home internet suddenly stops working on ALL phones and laptops at once, what safe 1-minute step often resolves a stuck router?
questions.option_c: Factory-reset every phone in the house
questions.option_d: Power-cycle the router: turn it OFF, wait 15–30 seconds, and turn it back ON

questions.question_text: What does "NFC" (Near Field Communication) on modern phones and smart cards allow?
questions.option_d: Tap-to-pay or instant pairing when held within a few centimeters of a reader/tag

questions.question_text: When you type `mapleskhatauli.com` in your browser, which behind-the-scenes internet phonebook translates that friendly name into the server’s numeric IP address?
Your internet speed test shows `100 Mbps` (Megabits per second). Since 8 bits = 1 Byte, roughly how many Megabytes (`MB`) can download in 1 second?
Why is setting up a separate "Guest Wi-Fi" network on a home or school router a smart security practice for visitors?
questions.option_a: Visitors get internet access while keeping your main school/home computers and shared printers isolated and private
questions.option_b: Guest Wi-Fi doubles your ISP plan speed

questions.question_text: What is "USB Tethering" between a smartphone and a desktop PC that has no Wi-Fi adapter?
questions.option_a: Sharing your phone’s internet connection directly to the desktop PC through a normal USB charging/data cable!
questions.option_b: Tying the phone to the desk with a rope
questions.option_c: Printing photos directly from SIM card

questions.question_text: What is the role of a "Firewall" in Windows or a school router?
questions.option_a: It prevents physical fire in the computer room
questions.option_b: It monitors incoming and outgoing network traffic and blocks unauthorized outside connections
questions.option_d: It heats up the CPU in winter

questions.question_text: Why should you change the default admin login (`admin / admin`) printed on the bottom sticker of a new home Wi-Fi router?
questions.option_c: Anyone connected nearby who knows common default logins could open router settings and change your Wi-Fi or DNS!
questions.option_d: Otherwise Wi-Fi turns off after 24 hours

questions.question_text: What does your "Digital Footprint" mean?
questions.option_b: The size of your laptop in inches
questions.option_c: The lasting trail of posts, comments, photos, and public activity associated with you on the internet
questions.option_d: Walking barefoot in the computer lab

questions.question_text: Why is downloading "Cracked / Pirated" paid software or game cheats from shady websites dangerous as well as unethical?
questions.option_a: Official free alternatives like VLC, GIMP, or LibreOffice do not exist
questions.option_c: Cracked software runs faster and safer than official apps
questions.option_d: Besides disrespecting creators’ work, pirated cracks are one of the #1 ways password-stealing malware infects home PCs!

questions.question_text: Before clicking "Save Password" when Chrome asks on a shared school or cyber-café computer, what should you ALWAYS choose?
questions.option_a: Click "Save" so you never have to type again
questions.option_b: Write your password on a sticky note on the monitor
questions.option_c: Share it with the café owner
questions.option_d: Click "Never" — saving your password on a shared computer lets the next person log straight into your account!

questions.question_text: In a class study WhatsApp/Telegram group, what keeps the group helpful and respectful for everyone?
questions.option_a: Starting personal arguments in front of 60 people
questions.option_b: Keeping messages relevant, polite, avoiding late-night spam chains, and respecting classmates’ opinions
questions.option_c: Sending 80 stickers in a row at midnight

questions.question_text: Why do phones and Windows regularly release "Security Updates"?
questions.option_c: To patch newly discovered security holes so hackers and malware cannot exploit them

questions.question_text: If a classmate accidentally left their Gmail open on a school lab computer, what is the ONLY ethical thing to do?
questions.option_a: Immediately click "Sign Out" without reading a single email, and politely let them know to be careful next time
questions.option_b: Send a prank email from their account
questions.option_d: Read their private emails for fun

questions.question_text: Sometimes AI chatbots confidently make up a fake book title, date, or fact that sounds very believable. What should you do before putting AI facts into a school project?
questions.option_a: Verify important facts, dates, and quotes from a reliable textbook or trusted official website
questions.option_b: Assume computers can never be wrong

questions.question_text: Why is keeping phones on silent and putting screens away at least 30–45 minutes before sleep recommended by doctors?
questions.option_b: Bright late-night screens and endless notifications disturb deep sleep and leave you tired in class the next morning

questions.question_text: If you receive an uncomfortable, threatening, or scam message from an unknown account online, what 3 steps protect you best?
questions.option_b: Keep it secret and worry alone
questions.option_c: Do NOT reply or argue — take a screenshot as proof if needed, Block/Report the account, and tell a trusted parent or teacher
questions.option_d: Send them your phone number to argue back

questions.question_text: What is "Plagiarism" in school projects and digital work?
questions.option_c: Saving a backup copy on a pendrive
questions.option_d: Copying someone else’s article, code, or artwork and presenting it as your own original work without credit

questions.question_text: When sitting at a computer desk for an hour, what healthy posture avoids neck and back ache?
questions.option_a: Bend your neck 90 degrees inches from the keyboard
questions.option_c: Keep the monitor on the floor
questions.option_d: Sit upright with feet flat, shoulders relaxed, and top of the screen near eye level rather than hunching low

questions.question_text: What is India’s official national Cyber Crime Helpline number (and portal `cybercrime.gov.in`) in case a family member faces online financial fraud?
What is a "Deepfake" video or voice clip that everyone on social media needs to be aware of today?
questions.option_c: An AI-manipulated video or cloned voice that makes a real person appear to say or do something they NEVER actually did
questions.option_d: A backup stored deep inside a folder

questions.question_text: Someone calls your parent in panic using a realistic-sounding voice saying "Send ₹10,000 urgently to this new number, don’t tell anyone!" What is the smart verification habit?
questions.option_a: Pause, hang up, and call the family member directly on their REAL known phone number to verify before sending a rupee!
questions.option_b: Share bank OTPs on the call
questions.option_c: Install a screen-sharing app they suggest
questions.option_d: Transfer money within 10 seconds in panic

questions.question_text: Why do scammers urgently ask victims to install remote screen-sharing apps (like AnyDesk / TeamViewer / unknown `.apk`s) during fake "KYC / customer care" calls?
questions.option_a: Because screen-sharing lets the scammer see your live phone screen, including incoming bank OTPs and apps!
questions.option_b: To clean dust from your phone speaker
questions.option_c: To double your mobile battery life
questions.option_d: Banks require AnyDesk for every account

questions.question_text: When designing a club registration form (Data Minimization principle), which information is ethical and sensible to collect?
questions.option_a: Parents’ bank account numbers and Aadhaar passwords
questions.option_b: Only what is genuinely needed for the club (Name, Roll No, Class, Section) — never unnecessary private family/financial data!
questions.option_d: Home Wi-Fi passwords of every student

questions.question_text: What does a "Creative Commons (CC)" license on an online photo or music track tell students making a video project?
questions.option_a: Nobody is allowed to view the image
questions.option_b: You can sell it as your own painting without credit
questions.option_c: The creator has given clear permission to reuse the work under stated conditions (such as giving proper attribution/credit)

questions.question_text: What should families do with old dead batteries, broken chargers, and discarded electronics ("E-Waste") instead of burning them or tossing them in open drains?
questions.option_a: Break screens with a hammer in class
questions.option_c: Burn plastic circuit boards in the backyard
questions.option_d: Hand them over to authorized E-Waste collection/recycling centers so toxic metals don’t pollute soil and water
